g.text: Will a team still deliver in two years?
Is there talent for my stack?
Can I contract, protect IP and pay?
Background, no bearing on the decision
Each dot is one of 78 claims in the AI report, placed under the buyer's question it bears on (our mapping) and coloured by our verdict

text.style: font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: Most claims answer the easy question; the three that decide a deal get eleven
